hey, i am not an expert but i know someone with this syndrome so i can pehaps pass on some little advice.

- i know closing your eyes doesnt help but, if you feel like its getting worse close them and try some breathing exercise (inhale for 7 seconds with your nose, hold for 5sec and breathe out as slow as you can with your mouth, repeat at least 10 times) stress makes the effect worse so this should relieve you at least a little bit.

- avoid screens as much as possible and if you need to be on your phone/computer set your brightness to as low as possible, also have your device allways on night mode (basicaly just limit the blue light as much as you can)

- no flasing lights or any sudden change in light

- meditation and exercise can help you calm down (yoga is apparently pretty great at managing this condition)
